spotify.markdown:
# Spotify

Search, play, queue and like on Spotify from the panel, with a lyrics view that follows the song and a bar item that shows the line playing.

## What it does

- Signs in to your own Spotify app with PKCE: no secret, the refresh token kept by pal
- Search as you type: tracks, artists, albums, playlists, podcasts and episodes in sections with their cover art; Enter plays, cmd+enter queues, cmd+l likes, cmd+o opens in Spotify
- Playlists (yours and followed, with a drill-in per playlist), Library (Liked Songs, recently played, top tracks and artists), Devices (transfer, volume) and the Queue (skip to a row)
- A lyrics view: the cover, a ticking progress bar, shuffle, repeat and like, and lrclib's synced lyrics around the line playing, the cover's colour as a tint; space, arrows, l, s, r, q, d
- Root rows for play or pause, next, previous, like, and "Play <playlist>" for each pinned playlist
- A bar item with the track or the lyric line playing; the popover is the lyrics view, ticking, with the whole transport on keys
- Rate limits honoured (a 429 is waited out or shown with its time), the token refreshed early, offline and no-device states as one line

![The lyrics view: the cover, the progress, the line playing bright among the lines around it](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/1-lyrics.png)
![The same view on the dark panel, the cover's colour under the art](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/2-lyrics-dark.png)
![Search: tracks, artists, albums, playlists and podcasts as sections](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/3-search.png)
![Playlists: yours and the followed ones; cmd+enter lists a playlist's tracks](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/4-playlists.png)
![Library: Liked Songs newest first, the other filters on Tab](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/5-library.png)
![The queue: what plays now, what comes next, Enter skips to a row](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/spotify/screenshots/6-queue.png)

## Lyrics

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `space, enter` | Play or pause |
| `left, right` | Seek 10 s back or forward |
| `up, down` | Volume up or down |
| `l` | Like or unlike |
| `s` | Shuffle on or off |
| `r` | Repeat: all, one, off |
| `q` | The queue |
| `d` | Devices |
| `cmd+right, cmd+left` | Next or previous track |
| `cmd+c` | Copy the line playing (the track without lyrics) |
| `cmd+o` | Open in Spotify |
| `f` | Search lrclib when it has no lyrics |

## Search Spotify

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Play |
| `cmd+enter` | Add to queue (a track); show tracks (a playlist or album) |
| `cmd+l` | Like or unlike a track |
| `cmd+s` | Play a playlist shuffled |
| `cmd+o` | Open in Spotify |
| `cmd+c` | Copy link |

## Playlists

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Play |
| `cmd+enter` | Show tracks (a playlist); add to queue (a track of one) |
| `cmd+s` | Play shuffled |
| `cmd+l` | Like or unlike a track of a listed playlist |
| `cmd+o` | Open in Spotify |
| `cmd+c` | Copy link |

## Library

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `tab` | Liked Songs, Recently played, Top tracks, Top artists |
| `enter` | Play |
| `cmd+enter` | Add to queue |
| `cmd+l` | Like or unlike |
| `cmd+o` | Open in Spotify |
| `cmd+c` | Copy link |

## Spotify Devices

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Play here (a device); volume up, down, mute (the volume rows) |
| `cmd+enter` | Transfer without playing |
| `cmd+up, cmd+down` | Volume of the active device |

## Queue

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Skip to the row (play or pause on the first) |
| `cmd+l` | Like or unlike |
| `cmd+o` | Open in Spotify |
| `cmd+c` | Copy link |

## Spotify

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Run |
| `cmd+s` | Play a pinned playlist shuffled |
| `cmd+o` | Open a pinned playlist in Spotify |

github.markdown:
# GitHub

Your pull requests, issues, repositories and notifications, and a search over all of GitHub. Signs in through the gh CLI or a token.

## What it does

- Pull Requests: yours, the ones waiting on your review, and what merged this week, with the checks, the review decision and a draft or conflicts tag on the row
- The detail pane on a pull request or issue: the body, the latest comments and reviews, every check by name, who approved
- Repositories: yours, your organisation's recently pushed and your stars; `cmd+e` opens the local clone in the editor
- Notifications by reason, newest first; `enter` marks the thread read and opens it, `cmd+shift+a` marks all read
- Search GitHub as you type: `repo:acme/widgets is:pr`, `author:mara`, `label:bug`, results sectioned by kind
- Create issue and Create repository as forms; Checkout branch and Merge from the row

![Pull Requests: Mine, Review requested and Merged, with the checks and the review decision on each row](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/github/screenshots/1-prs.png)
![The pane a pull request opens with: the body, the latest comments and reviews, every check by name](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/github/screenshots/2-pr-detail.png)
![Notifications by reason, newest first; the first row is the unread count](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/github/screenshots/3-notifications.png)
![Search GitHub: repositories, issues, pull requests and users for one query](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/github/screenshots/4-search.png)

## Pull Requests

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Open the pull request |
| `cmd+c` | Copy its URL |
| `cmd+shift+o` | Checkout the branch |
| `cmd+b` | Copy the branch name |
| `cmd+shift+k` | Open the checks |
| `cmd+shift+f` | Open the files changed |
| `cmd+shift+r` | Mark a draft ready for review |
| `cmd+shift+m` | Merge |
| `tab` | All, Mine, Review requested, Merged |

## Issues

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Open the issue |
| `cmd+c` | Copy its URL |
| `cmd+shift+x` | Close it |
| `tab` | All, Assigned, Mentioned, Created |

## Repositories

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Open on GitHub |
| `cmd+e` | Open the clone in the editor |
| `cmd+o` | Open the clone's folder |
| `cmd+shift+c` | Copy the clone URL |
| `cmd+c` | Copy the URL |
| `tab` | All, Mine, Starred, Organisation |

## Notifications

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Mark read and open |
| `cmd+shift+r` | Mark as read |
| `cmd+shift+a` | Mark all as read |
| `cmd+c` | Copy its URL |

## Search GitHub

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Open what was found |
| `cmd+c` | Copy its URL |
| `tab` | Everything, Issues and PRs, Repositories, Users |

timer.markdown:
# Timer

Named countdown timers over the `timer` CLI: the soonest one on the bar with a fill and a red alarm when it lands, the list, pause, resume and stop in the palette.

## What it does

- One row per timer, most urgent first: `3:12 left, done at 04:41 PM`, `Paused at 41:05`, `Landed 1:35 ago`, with a state tag
- New timer is a form: `25m`, `90s`, `1h30m` or a bare number of minutes, an optional name, and a checkbox to ring the phone when it lands
- `enter` pauses, resumes or dismisses; `cmd++` adds five minutes; `cmd+d` stops
- The CLI keeps the timers, so one started in a terminal and one started here are the same list
- A bar item with the soonest timer's countdown and a fill, blue to amber to red, an alarm once it lands; hidden with none

![Every timer with what is left: a landed one, two running, one paused, and New timer last](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/timer/screenshots/1-timers.png)
![New timer: a duration, an optional name, ring the phone when it lands](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/timer/screenshots/2-new.png)
![Pause, add five minutes, or stop a running timer](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/timer/screenshots/3-actions.png)

## Timers

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `enter` | Pause, resume or dismiss |
| `cmd++` | Add five minutes |
| `cmd+d` | Stop |

wordle.markdown:
# Wordle

The five-letter word game in the panel, keyboard only: type a word, Enter submits, the tiles flip. A daily puzzle from the date, practice games on N, the streak and the stats persist.

## What it does

- The board as a view level: letters type into the row, Enter submits, the row flips tile by tile into green, amber and grey; the on-screen keyboard colours as the letters are found
- A daily puzzle seeded from the date (`daily` setting): opening on a new day starts it, one word a day, the same on every machine
- `N` for a practice word once the day's puzzle is done (or any time with dailies off, as `cmd+n` mid-game)
- A word not in the list, or a hard-mode slip, is a red badge over the board; hard mode keeps greens in place and makes ambers count
- The result view: played, win %, streak and best, the guess distribution as bars, `C` copies the emoji grid for sharing
- Escape leaves at any point; the game and the stats are there when you come back, across restarts
- The word lists ship with the extension (public domain sources, see the README); nothing is fetched

![The daily, three guesses in and two letters typed: the keyboard shows what the guesses found](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/wordle/screenshots/1-game.png)
![A word that is not in the list: the badge over the board, the row stays for editing](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/wordle/screenshots/2-notice.png)
![Solved in four: the praise, the stats and the guess distribution, C copies the grid](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/wordle/screenshots/3-solved.png)

## wordle

| key | does |
| --- | --- |
| `a` | Type a letter |
| `enter` | Submit the guess |
| `backspace` | Delete a letter |
| `c` | Copy the result, once the game is over |
| `n` | New game, once the game is over |
| `cmd+n` | New game mid-game, when a practice word can be dropped |

gmail.markdown:
# Gmail

Your inbox as rows with the sender, the subject and the snippet; open a message in Gmail, mark it read, search with Gmail's own syntax, browse the labels; an unread count on the bar. One instance per account, each with its own token command; sending only where you turn it on.

## What it does

- Inbox: unread first then recent, each row with the sender's avatar (Gravatar, else the initial on a tinted tile), the subject, the snippet, the labels as chips, a paperclip when there is an attachment, the date
- Enter opens the message in Gmail at the thread; cmd+Enter marks it read; the pane shows the message as text with the quoted replies folded, the headers and the attachments listed
- Search Mail as you type with Gmail's own syntax (from:, subject:, has:attachment, newer_than:7d), the results sectioned by label
- Labels: every label, yours and Gmail's; open it in Gmail or search it here
- The bar item: the unread count, hidden at zero, refreshed every two minutes and on wake; the popover lists the newest five with Open and Mark as read
- Two accounts are two instances, each with its own token command, address, palettes and bar item, told apart by the title and the badge on the tile
- Sending is off per account until you turn it on: with it, Compose and Reply as forms, Drafts to send or discard, Archive and Star on a row. A work account stays read and mark-read only
- No secret in pal: a command of yours prints the token (gcloud, a helper, a broker), pal keeps it in memory until it expires

![Inbox: unread first, the sender's avatar, the subject and the snippet, the labels, a paperclip, the date](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/gmail/screenshots/1-inbox.png)
![The pane: the message as text, who and when, the labels, the attachments with their sizes](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/gmail/screenshots/2-detail.png)
![Search Mail: Gmail's syntax typed into the panel, the hits sectioned by label](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/gmail/screenshots/3-search.png)
![Labels: yours and Gmail's, Enter opens one in Gmail, cmd+Enter searches it here](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/gmail/screenshots/4-labels.png)
![Compose: to, cc, subject, body, the signature already under it; only with send on](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/gmail/screenshots/5-compose.png)
![Drafts: the recipient and the subject, send or discard after a confirmation](https://pal.cagdas.io/extensions/gmail/screenshots/6-drafts.png)
